assertions: Existing signed16 item now preserves native copy/mutation/typed Any/value equality/hash/plain-number presentation contracts.
Actual Calc merge flags reuse corrected shared behavior; areSame/itemset retain Which identity independently of payload equality.

stackDivergence.rationale: Task151 corrects the existing shared SfxInt16Item instead of creating a parallel text-metric wrapper. Original default/value/implicit-copy/factory/independent Clone and mutable SetValue are represented; direct payload equality now requires the same concrete native type and value while excluding WhichId. Original SfxPoolItem.areSame and item-set callsites retain Which/type guards, so different item identities remain distinct. Typed Any short QueryValue/PutValue ignore member selectors and preserve value on failed extraction, while the existing no-argument browser scalar projection and checked JS signed16 input domain remain explicit host boundaries, as for sibling numeric items. Original supportsHashCode/value-only size_t hash uses the existing unsigned64 logical hash convention, never persisted document bytes. Locale-independent GetPresentation uses real shared OUString.number without translated UI resources or an Intl provider. Actual ScMergeFlagAttr inherits corrected mutation/typed transport/hash and keeps original flag meanings and independent Clone, with no Calc/Writer compatibility branch. Two obsolete local direct-equality expectations are corrected to native Which-independent payload semantics; related Writer automatic/style/table/notification consumers are exercised. Native property-tree diagnostics/base serializer remain unported, no Boost or lifetime manager is added. Real text-metric subclasses/EditEngine/EditTextObject/Calc pool/model/connected UI/same-model ODS remain pending; UI localization is deferred. Existing semantic statuses and deliberate I/O/recovery deviations remain unchanged.
